title: My Favorite Meals
text:
Lunch is my favorite meal. Every day I eat rice with chicken and a green salad. I drink a glass of water with my meal. Fruit is my favorite dessert.

On weekends, my family cooks soup together. We eat it at the kitchen table. My father makes tea after dinner. Everyone likes it very much.

questions.text: What does the writer eat every day for lunch?
options: Rice with chicken and a green salad

questions.text: Why does the family eat together on weekends?
How does the writer probably feel about lunch?

vocabulary.definition: a sweet food eaten at the end of a meal
a warm liquid food made from vegetables, meat or fish
a cold dish of raw or cooked vegetables

paragraph_translations: Öğle yemeği en sevdiğim yemektir. Her gün tavuklu pilav ve yeşil salata yerim. Yemeğimle birlikte bir bardak su içerim. Meyve en sevdiğim tatlıdır.
Hafta sonları ailem birlikte çorba pişirir. Onu mutfak masasında yeriz. Babam akşam yemeğinden sonra çay yapar. Herkes bunu çok sever.
